card.name: Inside IV administration instructions
card.fires_on: Small words or spaces in the middle of IV and administration instructions, right before a specification such as fill volume, a filter size, or saline strength. Also fires on the 'of' in 'end-of-infusion'.

modes.label: Before a saline or filter spec
modes.description: A blank space token right before a number such as 0.9% Sodium Chloride or a 0.2-micron filter.
modes.example: flush with 30 mL of<< >>0.9% Sodium Chloride Injection

modes.label: Checklist item 'fill'
modes.description: The word 'fill' in a carton or syringe inspection list, just before 'volume'.
modes.example: drug strength -<< fill>> volume - route of administration

modes.label: Linking words in device or usage phrases
modes.description: A short linking word in a phrase about splitting tablets, alarms, or equipment.
modes.example: have occlusion, end<<-of>>-infusion, and low-battery alarms

card.plain: It marks the small joining words and spaces in preparation and infusion directions just before a volume, filter or saline detail.
